verified_facts.text: The resort sits on the cliffs east of the town center of St Andrews and has two 18-hole golf courses.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched atop the cliffs east of the town center, Fairmont St Andrews offers two exceptional 18-hole golf courses.

verified_facts.text: The resort stands on a 520-acre estate with cliff-top views of the North Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Offering a luxurious experience on a 520-acre estate with dramatic cliff-top views of the North Sea.

verified_facts.text: The Fairmont Spa treatments use products from ESPA Skincare and the Hebridean brand ishga.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in massages and facials enhanced by products from ESPA Skincare and the Hebridean luxury brand ishga.

verified_facts.text: Dining includes La Cucina, serving relaxed Italian-style food, and the St Andrews Clubhouse and Grill, with panoramic coastal views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose from a relaxed Italian style in La Cucina, or panoramic coastal views with our St Andrews Clubhouse and Grill.

verified_facts.text: Kittocks Bar and Zephyr Sports Bar suit family time, and Zephyr has a pool table and a sports simulator.
verified_facts.excerpt: Family time can be enjoyed in our Kittocks Bar, or Zephyr Sports Bar along with a pool table and Sports simulator.
Our 5-star golf resort boasts sumptuous accommodations, and four-bedroom Manor Homes.

verified_facts.text: The Manor Homes are self-catering, with open-plan living, a farmhouse-style kitchen, a dining room and golf course views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxury self-catering 4 Bedroom homes, Open Plan Living, 5 Bathrooms, Large Farmhouse Style Kitchen, Dining Room, Digital Free-View TV/Internet Access, Golf Course View

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites use rustic earth tones with tartan accents and have sea and golf course views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rustic earth tones in our luxury rooms and suites are complemented by sweeping sea and golf course views. Tartan accents in homage to our proud Scottish heritage.

verified_facts.text: The Kingdom of Fife Suite is a one-bedroom king suite for families and friends, with a separate living and dining area and a private balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perfect for families and friends, this one bedroom king suite offers enhance views over the resort, a separate living & dining area, patio doors open onto a private balcony.

verified_facts.text: Dogs are welcome, and pets are allowed in the lobby, atrium and hallways and in certain pet-friendly rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: We're delighted to welcome your dog. We recommend the stunning beaches to let your dogs run free or a free-play at St Andrews Dog Run. Pets are allowed in the Lobby, Atrium and hallways alongside certain pet-friendly rooms

verified_facts.text: The resort runs an airport Meet and Greet service and private transfers and tours; transport requests need 24 hours' notice.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our resort transport department operates an airport 'Meet and Greet' service, private transfers and tours with our fleet of executive vehicles. We require 24 hours for any transport requests.

verified_facts.text: Golf lessons with a PGA professional are offered.
